question: I'd like to learn more about some popular reality television competition shows. As of the end of the 44th season of the American version of Survivor, how many more unique winners have there been compared to the number of winners of American Idol?

history.name: user
history.content: I'd like to learn more about some popular reality television competition shows. As of the end of the 44th season of the American version of Survivor, how many more unique winners have there been compared to the number of winners of American Idol?

history.content: Search result summary: Survivor has had 44 seasons, with two repeat champions (Sandra Diaz-Twine and Tony Vlachos). mistake_reason: Formatting Error (FM-4.4): WebSurfer was instructed to return JSON only but responded with conversational text and malformed JSON using single quotes, a trailing comma, and a string type for a numeric field: { 'idol_winners': '22', 'cutoff': '2024-05', }. This broke the parser, causing the orchestrator to fall back to the visible (but temporally misaligned) 22 winners figure for American Idol, leading to the incorrect difference (20 instead of the ground-truth 21).
